# Logging and telemetry

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_agent_rules.py from rules.yml; do not edit by hand. Implements AGT-010, AGT-011. Only rules that no CI job or linter enforces. -->

- Logging and telemetry MUST be configured in exactly one module (`observability.py`), called once from the composition root (OBS-002).
- Log events MUST use a stable snake_case event name as the message (`policy_lookup_failed`) with data in key-value fields, never interpolated into the string (OBS-005).
- Exceptions MUST be logged once, at the boundary that handles them, with the traceback in a structured field (`exc_info`) (OBS-008).
- Key-name redaction is a safety net, not a control: code MUST NOT pass request bodies, prompts, documents or customer identifiers into log fields in the first place (OBS-010).
- Span attributes, metric labels and log fields MUST NOT contain personal, health, financial or beneficiary data or secrets (OBS-011).
- Metric label sets MUST be bounded (enumerations, route templates, status classes) (OBS-021).
- Log levels: ERROR only for failures needing action, WARNING for degraded-but-served, INFO for business events, DEBUG off in production by default (OBS-007).
- Operational logs MUST NOT be used as the audit trail; they may be sampled, rotated or dropped (OBS-029).
- Regulated decisions MUST write an audit record separate from application logs, containing who or what acted, which model and prompt version, inputs by reference (not content), outcome, timestamp and correlation ID (OBS-027).
- Exactly one distro or manual SDK initialisation MUST exist per process (OBS-014).
- Tracing export is not set up in this template; do not initialise an OpenTelemetry distro without the ADR.
